activation_rules: Create a new immutable runtime plan for one named agency/commodity/date cohort; select actual PSC/NAICS codes from official source definitions before querying.
Demonstrate acquisition of a priced line and its terms, or explicitly document why that sector cannot yet support a price test.
Use a complete declared population when claiming repeated pattern prevalence; a first page supports only sample observations.
Verify an independent source route and comparison requirements before expanding volume.
Reserve a separate independent reviewer and explicit source budgets.
Retain an explained/no-support control and report blocked coverage; expansion does not require finding fraud.

waves.first_selection: FSC5306 first, then a separately reviewed commodity code
waves.candidate_sources: DIBBS original lines; public FLIS/PUB LOG; supplier catalogs
waves.critical_control: Certification, traceability, supply urgency and aircraft/weapon-system-specific requirements can destroy a retail match.

waves.first_selection: PSC6515; pick one exact product family
waves.match_key: Manufacturer/catalog model + pack + sterile/reusable status + warranty
waves.candidate_sources: VA CCST and authorized price lists; public solicitation/order attachments
waves.critical_control: Schedule catalog price is not the transaction price; service, installation and training bundles matter.

waves.agency_scope: USACE, GSA and agency construction offices
waves.first_selection: A named project and defined bill-of-quantities trade
waves.match_key: Specification revision + measured quantity + installed scope + site/date
waves.candidate_sources: Public solicitation schedules, amendments and released change-order records
waves.critical_control: Installed rates include labor, site conditions, waste, risk and plant; retail material price alone is not a benchmark.

waves.first_selection: One exact SKU/license or labor category and one contract type
waves.match_key: SKU/version + license rights + seat/term + support; or role/level/location + hours
waves.candidate_sources: Public order attachments, schedule catalogs and public CALC+ ceiling data
waves.critical_control: License bundles and services differ; public ceilings cannot be relabeled actual paid rates.

waves.first_selection: One fuel grade/location/delivery basis per declared period
waves.match_key: Fuel specification + quantity + delivery point + pricing date/formula
waves.candidate_sources: Released contracts and published market index terms
waves.critical_control: Taxes, storage, freight, hedging formula and location basis require separate controls.

waves.agency_scope: DLA, military transport and civilian logistics offices
waves.first_selection: One lane, cargo type and service level
waves.match_key: Origin/destination commercial route + cargo + distance + timing + accessorials
waves.candidate_sources: Released rate schedules, orders and amendments
waves.critical_control: Emergency transport, hazardous cargo, empty return, demurrage and accessorial services explain many differences.

waves.agency_scope: NIH, other HHS agencies and research offices
waves.match_key: Catalog lot/grade + quantity + shelf life + calibration/service
waves.candidate_sources: Public procurement lines and manufacturer offers
waves.critical_control: Grant expenditure summaries and reimbursement data do not identify the actual purchased instrument or specimen service.

waves.agency_scope: Named awarding offices selected from foundation coverage map
waves.first_selection: One agency/commodity question per new plan
waves.match_key: Sector-specific economic unit, exact item/service and applicable period
waves.critical_control: Food, disaster, education, justice, housing and other purchases need sector-specific terms; grant/benefit programs require a different payment/eligibility model.

outside_current_price_model: Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement, grants, benefits, loans, tax and customs assessments: do not treat them as ordinary government item purchases. Reuse foundation sector research but design their own eligibility, service and payment models.
